Memory_91 shows activation messaging drove week-one engagement and meaningful first actions. Memory_86 demonstrates onboarding shortening improved adoption—these two interventions are complementary and memory_91's approach is proven to work on the exact metric declining. Verifying both ensures we understand the interaction effect and baseline performance.
